title: Failure Review Window for Home Delivery Pharmacy Accounts
content:
## Training note: counting shipment failures

**Rule.** For a Home Delivery Pharmacy account, the failure review window depends on how long the account has been open on the handling date: for an account open 60 whole months or more it covers replacements dated less than 24 whole months before the handling date, for an account open less than 12 whole months it covers replacements dated less than 6 whole months before, and for every other account it covers replacements dated less than 12 whole months before.

Months open are whole months from the account's opened date to the handling date.

### Questions answered

**How far back are replacements counted for a long-standing account?** For an account open 60 whole months or more, replacements dated less than 24 whole months before the handling date.

**And for a new account?** For an account open fewer than 12 whole months, replacements dated less than 6 whole months before the handling date.

**And for every other account?** Replacements dated less than 12 whole months before the handling date.

### Window table

| Whole months open on the handling date | Replacements counted are those dated less than |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 24 whole months before |
| 12 through 59 | 12 whole months before |
| fewer than 12 | 6 whole months before |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- 60 whole months open: 24-month window; 59: 12-month window.
- 12 whole months open: 12-month window; 11: 6-month window.
